summary: Prepare defensible GHG inventories, improve Scope 3 data, and strengthen assurance readiness. Explore the practical carbon accounting course.
lede: Corporate greenhouse-gas accounting training helps sustainability, ESG, finance, procurement and environmental teams prepare organisational and value-chain inventories. Participants practise setting boundaries, screening Scope 3 categories, assessing activity data and emissions factors, and documenting calculations and supplier evidence, then develop an inventory methodology and prioritised improvement plan.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who compile, review, govern, or use organisational and value-chain greenhouse-gas data.
prerequisites: Recommended: familiarity with organisational sustainability reporting, procurement, finance, or environmental data. No programming is required. Bring a laptop for spreadsheet-based exercises; no specific software installation is assumed.
